newsitem.title: POLAND: Port conditions update - Poland - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Poland - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

POLAND, July 18 - Szczecin - Level of water in the port 503 cms, alarm level 580 cms. Worst case scenario, in case of north wind, the level of water may reach 150 cms higher then the alarm level of 5.8 metres. According to latest reports, high water was expected in Szczecin at 0700, July 26. Port and yards will stop activity during flooding time.
